_source: Coloring activity (activity_template type 43) picture rewards: activity_template config_data pairs a picture with an award id that no table defines, so the server holds what each gives. Keyed by that award id: drops [[DROP_TYPE, id, count]...] and random [{count, pool [[DROP_TYPE, id]...]}], one pool entry drawn uniformly per unit. From azurlane.koumakan.jp Happy Lunar New Year 2024 / 2025 / 2026 pages (An Shan's Drawing Book / Drawing Book, Rewards table, read 2026-10-20): T3 Random Skill Book = one of the T3 Offensive/Defensive/Support books (16003/16013/16023), Red Envelope = the year's red packet virtual item (link_id the type 64 activity of the same event: 60025 for 5188, 60026 for 5779, 60027 for 50416), T3 Main Gun Parts = 17013, Plum-Petal Poetry = equipment 3800, An Shan 501011, Ying Swei 502041, Chao Ho 502051.
